title: logast user config (~/.config/logast/config.yaml)
description: Settings of this machine's logast user: where fleets and the knowledge base live. $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/logast/config.yaml, else ~/.config/logast/config.yaml.

dir.description: Folder that holds the named fleets (default: $XDG_DATA_HOME/logast/fleets, else ~/.local/share/logast/fleets; LOGAST_FLEETS and --fleets-dir win)

paths.description: A fleet kept elsewhere (a clone of its git repo): name → folder

kb.description: The knowledge base logast mcp and the kb commands read

paths.description: Fact files or folders to load (LOGAST_KB and --kb win)

install.gradle.description: install.sh: a remembered "no" to the Gradle setup (plugin in Maven Local, init script); install.sh --ask asks again

install.supportLocal.description: install.sh: a remembered "no" to putting the support library into Maven Local

install.supportRemote.description: install.sh: "no", or <target>@<version> the support library was last published to (--publish-to)
